title: Liu et al. 2025 — Lower limb motor imagery EEG dataset based on the multi-paradigm and longitudinal-training of stroke patients (Tianjin University)
description: This dataset comprises scalp EEG recordings from 27 stroke patients undergoing rehabilitation, collected during a lower-limb motor-imagery paradigm using a multi-paradigm, longitudinal-training protocol. It supports research into motor-imagery brain-computer interfaces (BCI) for lower-limb and gait rehabilitation after stroke. The data were originally described in a Scientific Data descriptor and have been converted to BIDS format for this NEMAR record.
methods_description: Scalp EEG recordings were acquired during a lower-limb motor imagery task (`task-imagery`) in stroke patients undergoing rehabilitation. The study employed a multi-paradigm protocol with a longitudinal training design involving repeated sessions across 27 participants.
